title: Share Your Voice on ElevenLabs and Earn: Voice Library Payouts
desc:
Only Professional Voice Clones can be published to the ElevenLabs Voice Library, and owners earn cash rewards when paid users generate audio with them. This episode covers what can be shared, the path from clone to library, the publishing steps and naming rules, notice periods, Live Moderation and other sharing settings, how payouts reach you through Stripe Connect, tax certification, private sharing links, and how to add and use the creator's own shared voice from the link in the description.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
